name: INFOSI Data Center e Cloud do Governo (Camama)
developer: INFOSI (Instituto Nacional de Fomento da Sociedade de Informacao) / MINTTICS
notes: Government cloud DC between Camama and Kilamba, Luanda, inaugurated 2026-04-28 by President Joao Lourenco; USD 89M national-cloud project (MINTTICS 2023: ~5,320 sqm prefab two-storey main DC); press B/C rack/MW figures (208/336 racks, ~1.04 MW) unconfirmed - capacity kept null.

name: INFOSI Centro Nacional de Dados backup (ITEL/Rangel)
notes: Backup/DR government data center at Centro Nacional de Dados next to ITEL in Rangel, Luanda, modernized under the USD 89M national-cloud project; capacity null unless primary source states it.

name: AngoNAP Luanda
notes: Carrier-neutral colo data center at Avenida Pedro de Castro Van-Dunem Loy, Luanda; official operator page confirms service; rack/MW figures third-party only (C); do not count AngoNAP Fortaleza (Brazil).

name: Raxio Group AO1 (Cacuaco)
notes: Opened 2025-10-02 in Cacuaco, Luanda; official release: USD 30M, 19,000 sqm campus, 3 MW IT power, 800+ racks, Tier III; designed to scale to 7 MW within five years (directory 7 MW values are expansion, not current).

name: Paratus Angola DC1 (ITA, Patriota)
notes: First Luanda campus data center launched 2017, capacity for 1,500 servers (DCD); official Paratus services page confirms Angola data center operations; ISO 9001/27001 and PCI-DSS certified; capacity_mw null (directory 2 MW is C-grade).

name: Paratus Angola DC2 (ITA, Benfica)
notes: Second Luanda campus data center launched 2019, can host up to 7,000 servers (DCD); official Paratus services page confirms Angola data center operations; capacity_mw null.

name: Paratus Angola third data center (Tier-IV-by-design)
notes: Official 2023 announcement: third Angola DC in Luanda with >10 MW IT, >2,000 cabinets, 30,000 sqm plot, first Tier-IV-by-design in Angola per trade press; no confirmed construction start/opening found this run - keep planned.

name: Africell Angola Kings Tower Data Center
notes: Opened October 2021 at Africell Angola HQ, Kings Tower building, central Luanda; cloud-based data center supporting mobile network and local hosting; capacity not public.

name: Unitel Luanda data center (Luanda Sul / Filda)
notes: C-grade lead: aggregator claims Unitel announced USD 22M expansion of its Luanda data center (+40% capacity); 2013 Agence Ecofin notes a mobile-network supervision centre in south Luanda; requires Unitel official/press/procurement corroboration before A/B.

name: AnyConnect / Visium Lubango disaster-recovery data center
notes: 2025 USD 60M digital-infrastructure MOU with Visium Technologies includes a secondary DR facility in Lubango (Huila) and fibre deployment; no binding official/operator site, financing, or construction evidence found - keep planned B/C.
